Method of Attack: Magecart card-skimming script injected into the certificate.js script of the Shopper Approved plugin to steal payment card data
Impacted Systems: Online merchants using the Shopper Approved plugin on their websites
Attack Vector: Compromise of the Shopper Approved plugin used by online merchants
Indicators of Compromise: certificate.js script containing Magecart skimming code
drop server used to receive payment card data (same as used in Feedify hack)
